messages:
aparna: quick heads-up, training noticed several optimize examples fail in the migration smoke tests — java, node, and rust snippets. can someone triage?

jess: on it. CI log shows rust binding error and node using legacy import path: `@redwood/optimize/legacy/QuantProfile`.

samir: runtime consolidated profiles into `optimize.profiles` namespace last week. java should import `com.redwood.optimize.profiles.QuantProfile` now. also batching key moved to `max_batch_tokens`.

riley: I'll patch the rust example to use the new FFI name and bump the example to 0.3.2; node + java fixes are straightforward.

aparna: please also add a tiny "Migration checklist" snippet at top of optimize/README with before/after one-liners for each language, and a note about config key rename so customers scanning the page see it.

jess: opening PR 4392 with fixes + a docs CI grep that fails on `optimize/legacy` imports and a small QA checklist file: docs/optimize/MIGRATE_QUANT.md.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (failed) — snippet-runner failed on rust example. https://ci.redwood/4392

riley: fixed rust binding and tightened the fenced code block (was an indentation issue). pushed.

samir: added a smoke test in the docs pipeline: run snippet-runner for java,node,py,rust on each PR. low overhead, good coverage.

jess: PR 4392 updated: fixes applied, MIGRATE_QUANT.md added, grep CI rule included. CI queued.

docs-bot: CI: docs-site / build (success) — all snippet tests passed.

aparna: nice. follow-ups: 1) matt to add a central docs-lint rule next sprint for old-imports, 2) riley to scan archived guides and tag any that need migration, 3) jess to add a short release-note blurb.

jess: noted, will send release note to product and link MIGRATE_QUANT.md. thanks y'all!
